# ✅ Feature Acceptance Review

## Feature metadata

- Name:
- Issue / pull request:
- Commit:
- Product owner:
- Reviewer:
- Date:

## Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Evidence / test | Result | Follow-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | pass / fail / blocked / not run | |

Do not mark a criterion as passed without evidence from the target commit.

## Functional checks

- [ ] Main success path
- [ ] Empty and invalid input
- [ ] Boundary values and maximum length
- [ ] Error and fallback behavior
- [ ] Keyboard operation
- [ ] Clear/reset behavior
- [ ] Existing behavior and rule precedence

## Non-functional checks

- [ ] Accessibility reviewed
- [ ] Responsive layout reviewed
- [ ] Browser compatibility considered
- [ ] Performance measured where relevant
- [ ] Security and privacy reviewed
- [ ] Dependency and bundle impact considered

## Documentation and support

- [ ] README / user guide updated
- [ ] Troubleshooting updated
- [ ] Architecture or data-flow diagrams updated
- [ ] Changelog and release notes prepared
- [ ] Known limitations stated accurately

## Decision

Accept / reject / needs changes. Record reason, owner, unresolved risk, due date, and exact commit reviewed.
